name: Delegated Code Review

configuration.title: Delegate this review?
configuration.message: Approve to send the scan findings to the configured Codex or Claude Code agent for an independent review. Configure an external agent target in Settings before running this workflow.

configuration.instructions: Review this repository. The additional context lists outstanding TODO, FIXME and HACK markers found by a workspace scan. Inspect the referenced files and report concrete risks, real defects, and missing tests, each with its file path. Be concise and do not restate the markers verbatim.

comments: Delegated Code Review: Chat Input → Tool (files.grep for TODO/FIXME/HACK) → Approval → External Agent (Codex/Claude Code) → Chat Output → Completion. Requires a configured external agent target in Settings.
